verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source library with a Dockerized FastAPI server and self-hosting docs, and it needs no forced API keys. Users therefore run it on infrastructure they pick, which implicitly decides where crawled data lives. Support for open-source LLMs means extraction can also stay within that environment. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of data storage location or residency controls, a managed-hosting option with region selection, and independent confirmation of the data-locality posture.
